items.headline: Bears' Caleb Williams to continue wearing Caddix 'smart cleats' despite fine
items.description: Bears quarterback Caleb Williams said Wednesday he will continue to sport the Caddix cleats he was fined $11,941 for wearing during Chicago's Week 6 win at Atlanta -- a fine that he has appealed, according to a source.
